title: White van first seen
detail: 5 m before the impact point, moving at 40 km/h (1.8 s before impact).

title: Peak speed 40 ± 14 km/h
detail: White van was at its fastest 1.8 s before impact. Uncertainty comes from the road calibration (±30%).

title: Could it have stopped?
detail: 1.6 s before impact White van was at 6 km/h with 2.6 m to go. A full stop (1 s reaction + braking) needs 2.0 m. A stop was possible; the highest speed that would have allowed a stop is about 31 km/h.

title: Braking began 1.5 s before impact
detail: At 6 km/h with 2.6 m left to the impact point. Braking alone needs about 0.2 m to stop from that speed, so a stop was possible.
